build.buildCommand: npm run build && mkdir -p .medusa/server/src && cp -r src/data .medusa/server/src/ && cd .medusa/server && npm install --omit=dev --no-audit --no-fund

deploy.startCommand: cd .medusa/server && npx medusa db:migrate && (npx medusa exec ./src/scripts/sync-products.js || echo '[startup] sync-products failed') && (npx medusa exec ./src/scripts/backfill-prices.js || echo '[startup] backfill-prices failed') && (npx medusa exec ./src/scripts/apply-price-uplift.js || echo '[startup] apply-price-uplift failed') && (npx medusa exec ./src/scripts/apply-sale-prices.js || echo '[startup] apply-sale-prices failed') && (npx medusa exec ./src/scripts/fix-product-claims.js || echo '[startup] fix-product-claims failed') && (npx medusa exec ./src/scripts/fix-image-urls.js || echo '[startup] fix-image-urls failed') && (npx medusa exec ./src/scripts/ensure-shipping-options.js || echo '[startup] ensure-shipping-options failed') && NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=768 npx medusa start
